system.description: The Curse of Caine did not grant you true immortality: you still age, albeit very slowly (roughly one mortal year per 20 calendar years survived), and eventually you will grow old and die. This is not usually noticeable, but whenever you heal a Health Level of aggravated damage, your deferred aging returns suddenly and you age an entire year over the following day's sleep — frequent exposure to sunlight or other sources of aggravated damage can age you rapidly.
